newsitem.title: UK: Deutsche BA orders seven Boeing 737s.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche BA orders seven Boeing 737s.

text.p: British Airways Plc said on Monday that its German regional carrier Deutsche BA (DBA) had placed an order to buy seven new Boeing 737 twinjets worth almost $300 million.
The airline said the aircraft were being acquired under a deal with Deutsche Structured Finance, with all seven aircraft to be delivered this year, starting in August.
BA said the new aircraft added to DBA's existing fleet of 10 737s and will replace its Fokker 100s for use on DBA's domestic services in single-class configuration.
It said the new aircraft were part of a major reorganisation of DBA which will include expanding the network and simplifying the fare structure.
"A single fleet of Boeing 737-300s will increase the company's efficiency and support the aim of providing reliable and punctual services," the company said in a statement.
Currently DBA flies seven domestic routes in Germany and three international routes to London Gatwick.
